_: What to SAY to the generator for an EFFECT still, one row per id. `tools/art/icon.mts vfx.json` reads it and `portrait.mts <id> <png> <grid> vfx` puts the result in `src/render/generated-vfx.ts`, which only Pixi draws — canvas2d has no sprites and keeps its blocks.
_how: An effect is drawn in the WORLD at about a tile across and is laid over a lit stone floor, so: no ground, no shadow, no actor holding it, and the thing itself is the only light in the frame.
_inks: Storm greys and near-black, with the game's own lightning gold (--citrine #D9A441) and a white core. A bolt is the one saturated ink.
how: A single EFFECT: ONE thing centred and filling the frame, seen straight from the side, BOLD readable silhouette with a hard dark outline, chunky shapes and few colours, lit only by itself. Transparent background. NOT a scene, NOT a landscape, NOT a character, NOT a hand holding it, NOT a ground shadow, NOT text, NOT a border, NOT a frame, NOT multiple objects.

icons.say: a single arrow flying level and pointing RIGHT, drawn horizontally across the middle of the frame: a dark wooden shaft, a sharp pale steel broadhead at the right end, three short grey feathers at the left end, and nothing else at all. NOT lightning, NOT sparks, NOT electricity, NOT a glow, NOT gold, NOT yellow, NOT fire, NOT a trail, NOT a bow, NOT a bowstring, NOT a hand, NOT a quiver, NOT a target, NOT an arrow pointing any other way.

ONE small dark RAIN CLOUD alone in empty space, seen from the side, wider than it is tall, dark blue-grey and heavy, lumpy billowed top, flat ragged underside, a faint warm gold glow buried inside it. Nothing at all beneath it: empty transparent space below the cloud and all round it. NOT an explosion, NOT a mushroom cloud, NOT a tornado, NOT a funnel, NOT a column, NOT a beam, NOT a stem, NOT a bolt, NOT rain falling, NOT a ground, NOT a shadow, NOT a horizon, NOT smoke, NOT a face.

ONE shallow POOL of thick sickly green poison lying flat on the ground, seen from ABOVE and slightly to the side, wider than it is tall: an irregular rounded splat with a ragged dripping edge, a few fat bubbles rising in it, a paler acid-green sheen across the middle and a dark bile-green rim. It sits alone in empty transparent space. NOT a sphere, NOT a ball, NOT a bottle, NOT a flask, NOT a cauldron, NOT a skull, NOT a face, NOT a splash rising up, NOT a ground, NOT a floor, NOT a shadow, NOT a container.

ONE single falling GLOB of thick sickly green poison, seen from the side, taller than it is wide: a fat rounded blob at the BOTTOM drawn out into a thin tapering tail above it, like a heavy droplet mid-fall, dark bile-green with a paler acid-green highlight down one side. It is alone in empty transparent space. NOT a bottle, NOT a flask, NOT a vial, NOT a bubble, NOT a leaf, NOT a flame, NOT a splash, NOT a puddle, NOT a ground, NOT a shadow, NOT rain, NOT several drops.
